messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — Customer showcase draft for HorizonPay is ready. Want to lock interview date + ask about including benchmark numbers and logo usage.
Ajay: Nice! Can you paste the one-pager? I can start social copy after we confirm quotes.
Maria: Pasting draft below:
Maria: ```Quick case: HorizonPay cut inference cost 3.2x and reduced p95 latency from 420ms -> 120ms after switching to Redwood Dedicated. Includes sample prompt, infra notes, and exec quote placeholder.```
Lisa: Date-wise, HorizonPay asked for week of May 6th. They prefer async Q&A or a 30-min recorded call. Which do we want?
Maria: Prefer live recorded call so we can pull soundbites. If exec availability is tight, we can do async. Ajay, can you prep 3 interview questions focusing on latency, cost, and integration?
Ajay: Yup — will post Qs by EOD. Rough ones: 1) What KPIs did you track? 2) What was migration time? 3) Biggest surprise after switching.
Samir: Legal note — we need explicit written permission for the logo and the exact quoted numbers. If HorizonPay wants anonymity for benchmarks, we can publish percentage improvements without the company name. Also request a redline window of 48 hours after we send the draft.
Maria: Good call. I'll ask them to confirm logo + quote signoff and offer anonymized option.
Priya: Routing note — any leads from the webinar or gated case will route to AE team. Can we route HorizonPay webinar registrants to my queue (priya@redwood)? If yes, I’ll set nurture flow.
Lisa: Yes, route to Priya. Also: webinar landing page needs a short abstract + 3 bullet benefits and an embedded CTA. Ajay — can you include that in copy?
Ajay: Draft abstract for landing page:
Ajay: "See how a payments platform scaled real-time recommendations while lowering inference costs — practical steps and metrics from bench to production."
Samir: Also add a legal footer: "Customer provided permission to publish data on [DATE]." I will prepare a one-click approval template for their legal team.
Maria: Sending to HorizonPay now. Will ask for: logo approval, quote confirmation, 48-hour redline, interview format preference, and permission to use anonymized numbers if they prefer.
Maria: Also proposed two social hooks for approval — please flag a favorite:
Maria: 1) "HorizonPay cut inference costs 3.2x with Redwood Dedicated — here’s how. [link]"
Maria: 2) "From 420ms to 120ms p95: a payments team shares their optimization playbook. Register for the webinar. [link]"
Ajay: I prefer #2 for webinar; #1 for the case study headline.
Priya: Agree. #2 converts better for signups.
Lisa: Logistics — recording ops: we'll use Zoom record to cloud, send transcript to the content team, and capture a 1-min promo clip. @Maria can you confirm who will moderate?
Maria: I can moderate. Ajay will handle Qs and pull quotes.
Samir: Once they send approval, share to #legal for one final look. LegalBot: AUTOMATED: Created approval checklist (case_study_approvals/1767284448). Please attach signed permission file within 7 days.
Maria: Thanks. I'll update thread when HorizonPay responds. :thumbsup:
Maria: UPDATE 1767284501 — HorizonPay legal OK'd logo + numbers, asked for 24-hour redline window, prefers recorded 30-min call on May 8 at 11:00 PT.
Lisa: Great — booking calendar now and reserving recording studio.
Priya: I set AE routing for registrants to priya@redwood and added webinar nurture flow.
Ajay: Posting interview Qs here for final review: 1) Walk us through the migration. 2) How did latency improvements change product metrics? 3) What advice for teams starting with Dedicated?
Samir: Looks good. Minor tweak to Q2: add "metrics you measured".
Maria: Sent final invite to HorizonPay, included the one-click legal approval link. Fingers crossed.
Maria: Last note: can someone draft a short 2-line internal product blurb we can share with SRE/Platform before publish? Need it by May 10.
Ajay: I'll take that.
